children: Florida real estate development and hospitality company St. Joe said it created a new business, Watersound Weddings & Events, to assist customers planning weddings and special events at the company's properties.
The new business brings together a dedicated team to help customers explore venues, accommodations and related resources across St. Joe's hospitality portfolio, the company said.
Jorge Gonzalez, St. Joe chief executive officer, said the new company creates a related business requiring minimal capital investment, and which leverages existing assets and capabilities.
Watersound services are currently available, the company said. A physical location at Watersound Town Center in Inlet Beach, Florida is expected to open early next year.
